summary: Hubbell Inc. filed an 8-K on May 1, 2026, announcing its acquisition of NSI Industries via a Stock Purchase Agreement. Hubbell will acquire all outstanding capital stock of NSI Electrical Buyer, Inc. for $3.0 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments. The acquisition targets NSI, a provider of electrical fittings and wire management products. Hubbell plans to finance the deal with cash-on-hand and debt. Closing conditions include HSR waiting period expiration, representations accuracy, and no Material Adverse Effect. The transaction is not expected to close before May 31, 2026, and can be terminated after eight months. Watch for antitrust clearance and financing details.
